channel.title: DeepSeek Research & News
channel.description: Research and news from the official DeepSeek website.

item.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 is now DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus
item.description: DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus improves language consistency, reduces CN/EN mix-ups, and upgrades Code Agent & Search Agent performance.

item.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
item.description: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp debuts DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for faster, more efficient training & inference on long context, with API prices cut by 50%+.

item.title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
item.description: DeepSeek-V3.2 and V3.2-Speciale launch with world-leading reasoning, thinking in tool-use, and gold-medal performance in IMO, CMO, ICPC & IOI 2025.

item.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview: Entering the Era of Affordable Million-Token Context
item.description: DeepSeek-V4 Preview is officially live & open-sourced. Welcome to the era of cost-effective 1M context length.

item.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: smarter, faster, more efficient.
item.description: Introducing the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native visual understanding. Designed for greater capability, faster inference, and higher throughput.
